NewsArticle.Title: New Contest: Event
NewsArticle.Content:
Deadline: 00.10.07
Get official recognition and rewards for your in-character and fun events.
This is a cooperative contest. The Game Director recognizes up to four Aislings as hosts for each qualifying event.
Event planned, organized, and hosted by characters, and must be in-character. Four Aislings will receive full recognition. Disagreements of who are the host members disqualifies the entry. Disagreements about an event disqualify the event.
Interested? Please see details: [www.DarkAges.com/community/contest.html#evt](http://www.darkages.com/2000/community/contest.html#evt)
